notes: The association lists Kinsmen Kart Club at Dixon. The independently visible paved full circuit retains the northeastern bulb, central hairpin and two western hairpins. The small diagonal infield connector, pit access and neighboring dirt speedway are excluded. Fine corner alignment and driving direction remain draft. Independently digitized aerial centerline: 645.9 m. Direction, historical configuration and fine corner alignment remain draft; no course coordinates come from the comparison catalogue.

Estimated constant-width corridor: width is stored in track.json; inner, outer and ideal lines are calculated in the browser from the mapped trace. Local widening and earlier boundary corrections are not retained by this approximation.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 13 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the mapped trace, not an official length measurement. The saved start gate sets the simulation origin. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.
